decision: Carry forward the relational predictor, a simpler retrieval/transition reference, a targeted prerequisite repair, or no selection.
scope: One isolated fresh synthetic monophonic completed-block experiment; no E08 changes, MERT use, paid compute, natural/polyphonic work or second tuned evaluation.

split.group_unit: All 24 episodes and two extra unrevealed-future probes stay in the same group/split. Groups use a fresh namespace and independent seeds; E08 groups/stimuli are not imported.

temporal_rule.rule: A three-block cue predicts the observed successor of an earlier matching relative-pitch cue in the same auditory history, translated to the current cue register. When identical cues were followed by both alternatives, their predefined continuation distribution is balanced.
temporal_rule.demonstrations: Q=[base,base+u,base+v]; R=[base,base+w,base+v], u != w. One history binds Q to v-d and R to v+d; its paired history swaps these successors. Histories contain identical block-byte multisets/counts, pitch inventory and duration.
temporal_rule.current_sound: Final two history blocks are Q[0:2] in the query register; the current probe is Q[2] there. These three waveforms are byte-identical within each pair.
temporal_rule.counterbalance: Q/R demonstration order alternates evenly within each split; four distractor blocks are distributed before, between and after demonstrations using the group seed. Amplitude, harmonic mix and phase are group-shared and identical across bindings.

stimulus_parameters.novelty_constraint: choose d only where v-d != u; neither possible transposed continuation equals any current cue pitch

temporal_rule.construction_limit: This is a stipulated conditional prediction task, not evidence of human musical identity or subjective hearing.

transfer.family: Uniform transposition of the three-event query cue and predicted continuation relative to its earlier demonstration; no other transformation family.
transfer.novelty: Targets must not match a prior heard pitch in the episode or any development/calibration heard pitch, within .35 semitone; also require distinct waveform hashes. Training register <=22 and heldout transfer target >=25 by construction. Verify after evaluation without changing stimuli or criteria.
transfer.query_register_anchor: Current arrived probe pitch; no candidate set or continuation waveform supplied to predictor.

target.quantity: First continuation event pitch, represented as interval from the arrived probe; point forecast also reported in semitones relative to 220 Hz.
target.unknown_rule: Unavailable anchor yields unknown=1. An inferred interval outside [-24.5,24.5] contributes to unknown. Missing key/successor observations are not filled.
target.vocabulary_source: Fixed before development analysis; not estimated from evaluation targets.

observations.extractor: Versioned isolated model.py clean-block FFT peak estimator; completed .12s arrived blocks only. Raw continuous pitch, RMS, spectral concentration and availability retained. No E08 gate or logits used.
observations.uncertainty_limit: Availability and spectral concentration are instrument measurements, not calibrated note confidence. Prediction probabilities are separately calibrated.

mechanisms.present: Development marginal interval distribution; same probe anchor, no history dependency.
mechanisms.recency: Most recent observed one-pitch match and its already-observed successor; no match -> marginal.
mechanisms.transition: Absolute acoustic transition contexts, order selected from 1–3 on development.
mechanisms.retrieval_absolute: Full observed sequence-context key plus its observed continuation; development context candidates 2–4 blocks; absolute max pitch residual cutoff, weighted ties.
mechanisms.retrieval_transposed: Same sequence retrieval with least-squares uniform shift estimated from arrived key context; transform remembered successor by that shift. Development context candidates 2–4 blocks.
mechanisms.relational: Lightweight acoustic-memory attention/readout using pairwise interval geometry of observed context keys and their successor intervals. Development context candidates 2–3 blocks. Relationship encoding is explicit; only context/cutoff selection and probability parameters are fitted.
mechanisms.common_budgets: Same arrived observations, full 32-block capacity, no eviction, <=14 possible remembered context windows per prediction. Baselines may deliberately ignore information. All comparisons use the same target vocabulary and scoring; no heldout condition/group/seed/path/candidate identifiers enter any predictor.

development_selection.criterion: Mean log loss on development intact and ambiguous episodes, basic and rehearsal-transposition families combined; deterministic ties prefer shorter order then smaller cutoff.

calibration.purpose: Fit normalized predictive probability parameters only; no context/order/cutoff changes.
calibration.criterion: Mean log loss across calibration episodes; deterministic ties by smaller temperature, sigma, floor.

controls.intact: Paired bindings require different forecasts under identical current cue.
controls.reset: Process all earlier blocks, then clear every mechanism memory immediately before the final two history blocks. No eviction; explicit reset. Retained cue has no observed successor, so history advantage should disappear.
controls.removal: Replace both demonstration successor blocks with same-length zero waveform in both variants. Position/count budgets retained and paired prefixes become identical; unavailable pitches remain unknown.
controls.swap: Use counterpart history and score against its corresponding swapped future, never against the unswapped target. Forecast distribution must equal counterpart intact distribution.
controls.shuffle: Reverse order of the complete four-block demonstration chunks; preserve their within-chunk transitions and the current cue. This deliberately preserves useful information; performance need not fall to chance. It is not arbitrary note-order destruction.
controls.ambiguous: Demonstrate the same Q cue followed by both successors; paired episodes have identical prefix bytes and balanced A/B futures. Evaluate probabilities against the predefined .5/.5 outcome distribution.
controls.eligibility: Numerical capability/control/ambiguity requirements apply separately to each mechanism considered for A/B. A weak baseline failing a capability is not itself a data-validity failure.

causal_contract.worker: Separate subprocess imports only model.py plus numeric/stdlib dependencies. Receives strict init/config, arrive/raw-bytes, reset, forecast schemas; no evaluator IDs, truth, future objects, paths or candidate lists.
causal_contract.access_guard: After numerical initialization an audit hook rejects filesystem open/list/scandir, network, subprocess, system and ctypes access. One deliberate forbidden-open probe must be blocked. This is instrumented process separation, not an adversarial OS security sandbox.
causal_contract.forecast_log: Append-only exclusive-create hash-chained events.jsonl; fsync forecast distribution, point estimate, prefix/state hashes and code/config hashes before reveal; reveal is then logged/fsynced before the future block enters the extractor.
causal_contract.future_invariance: For the first intact history in each family/group substitute the other withheld future in the evaluator, request another forecast with unchanged worker state, and require byte-identical forecast payload. Count these extra requests conservatively in stream budget.
causal_contract.receipt: Publish protocol SHA-256 and aggregate execution code hash to PR #2 before heldout generation/evaluation.

metrics.group_weighting: All 24 heldout groups equally weighted. Paired success requires both intact variant point forecasts within tolerance. Correlated variants are not independent samples.
metrics.proper_log_loss: -sum(y_i log p_i), with y one-hot except predefined balanced ambiguous distributions.
metrics.brier: sum((p_i-y_i)^2), squared probability error against the known outcome distribution. For ambiguous trials expected realized Brier adds the constant .5; primary intact trials are conventional Brier.

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap; same group index samples for each mechanism/metric; quantiles .025,.975

metrics.comparisons: Relational minus EACH baseline on basic and transfer accuracy, paired success, log loss and Brier; report all. Strongest simpler mechanism selected by heldout transfer accuracy, then log loss, then fixed baseline order; no tuning to this selection.

branch_criteria.validity: All byte/inventory/duration, leakage/isolation, forecast/reveal/invariance, split, shared observation budget, eviction and control-truth semantics gates pass. A localized failure selects C; otherwise inconclusive. Invalid evidence cannot select A/B.
branch_criteria.basic: Group mean intact paired success >=.80; lower95 bound of accuracy improvement over present >0; reset/removal, swapped-history, preserved-information shuffle and basic ambiguity criteria pass.
branch_criteria.transfer: Group mean intact paired success >=.70 and transfer ambiguity criteria pass.
branch_criteria.A: Relational passes basic and transfer; >=.10 transfer accuracy advantage over strongest eligible simpler baseline; lower95 paired bound >0; no worse mean log loss or Brier. Retain relational prototype.
branch_criteria.B: Strongest simpler baseline passes basic and transfer accuracy difference CI is wholly inside [-.05,.05], with absolute mean log-loss difference <=.05 nats and Brier difference <=.02; OR simpler exceeds relational by >=.10 with positive lower95 paired bound and no worse proper scores. Retain simpler reference. If transfer fails both but basic/equivalence pass, retain basic capability only.
branch_criteria.C: A localized prerequisite observation/memory/readout or validity failure withholds affected capability; name exactly one targeted repair but do not execute after freeze.
branch_criteria.inconclusive: No justified A/B and no localized prerequisite failure: preserve result, make no architecture selection, stop.
branch_criteria.finite_sample_limit: A degenerate group-bootstrap interval when every group difference is identical describes this sample, not universal equivalence.

stopping: One frozen heldout evaluation; preserve failures, no tuning/retest, no additional experiment or automatic audit. Publish complete successor snapshot and branch receipt, then stop awaiting review.

required_checks_decisions.balance: Accept history-dependence comparison only if present/probe and byte inventories are balanced.
required_checks_decisions.causality: Trust anticipation claim only if no future access and forecast commitment precedes reveal.
required_checks_decisions.novelty: Accept transposition claim only if target unheard at that pitch in episode/training.
required_checks_decisions.scores: Accept branch choice only after independent forecast/proper-score arithmetic reconciliation.
required_checks_decisions.artifact_preservation: Accept snapshot only if frozen E08/prior blobs remain unchanged.

execution_provenance: Development/calibration store actual base revision plus dirty source snapshots and hashes. Heldout uses a committed frozen implementation/protocol/model revision; an untracked external preregistration receipt may make the worktree dirty without changing executable inputs. Final publication SHA is recorded separately.
